title: AMP body: session.confirm
description: body.type = 'session.confirm' — Client proves it holds the binding token.

session_id.description: Session ID from the session.established message
session_id.title: Session Id

binding_proof.description: HMAC-SHA256 under the derived binding key over the handshake transcript (see ampro.session.binding.compute_binding_proof)

confirm_nonce.description: Echo of the confirm_nonce from session.established. The server validates this via HandshakeStateMachine.consume_confirm_nonce() and raises SessionReplayError if replayed or unknown.
confirm_nonce.title: Confirm Nonce
